unresolved_issues.claim: The draft does not define which Game time anchors roster eligibility when a Game is rescheduled, postponed, started, finalized, or corrected, leaving Player Stat Line attribution and transfer legality ambiguous.

The allowed source states for transition to `forfeit` are less explicit than the rest of the Game lifecycle, which can cause inconsistent interpretation of whether an `in_progress` Game may become `forfeit`.
